# möbius for macOS 0.3.13

- See storage, chats, and projects in Settings. Export and selectively purge uploads, artifacts, and screenshots with a size-ranked cleanup sheet; generated images remain protected.
- Open local and gateway files in one viewer with its animated file tree, path breadcrumbs, and the Mac's discovered apps and icons.
- Show purged files and images clearly in chat history, and refine pinned chats, project headings, and storage controls.
- Use protocol 90 with the new gateway storage and telemetry system. Cloud desktops include reliable terminal and file icons and a cleaner browser window.

Includes core and gateway 0.16.9. Requires Apple Silicon, macOS 26 or later, and gateway protocol 90.
